Jehu said to him, ‘Is your heart upright with my heart, as my heart is with your heart?’ Jonadab said, ‘It is.’ Jehu said, ‘If it is, give me your hand.’ He gave his hand, and he brought him up to himself onto the chariot.

verses.text: He said to him, ‘Come with me and see me being zealous for the Lord Sabaoth.’ He seated him in his chariot.
verses.display_text: He said to him, ‘Come with me and see me being zealous for the Lord Sabaoth.’ He seated him in his chariot.

verses.text: He entered Samaria and struck all who remained of Ahab in Samaria until he made him disappear, according to the word of the Lord that He had spoken to Elijah.
verses.display_text: He entered Samaria and struck all who remained of Ahab in Samaria until he made him disappear, according to the word of the Lord that He had spoken to Elijah.

verses.text: Jehu gathered all the people and said to them, ‘Ahab served Baal a little; Jehu indeed will serve him much.’
verses.display_text: Jehu gathered all the people and said to them, ‘Ahab served Baal a little; Jehu indeed will serve him much.’

verses.text: ‘Now, all Baal’s prophets, summon to me all his slaves and his priests. Let no man be absent, for I have a great sacrifice for Baal. Whoever is absent will not live.’ Jehu acted with trickery, so that he might destroy Baal’s slaves.

verses.text: Jehu sent throughout Israel, saying, ‘Now, all Baal’s slaves, all his priests, and all his prophets, let no one stay away, for I am making a great sacrifice. Whoever stays away will not live.’ All Baal’s slaves, all his priests, and all his prophets came; not one man remained who did not arrive. They entered Baal’s house, and Baal’s house was filled from mouth to mouth.

verses.display_text: Jehu and Jonadab son of Rechab entered Baal’s house. He said to Baal’s slaves, ‘Search and see whether any of the Lord’s slaves are with you, for there must be only Baal’s slaves alone.’

verses.display_text: He went in to perform the sacrifices and whole burnt offerings. Jehu stationed eighty men outside for himself and said, ‘If any man is saved from the men I bring into your hands, his life shall be in place of his life.’

verses.text: When he finished performing the whole burnt offering, Jehu said to the runners and officers, ‘Go in and strike them. Let no man come out from them.’ They struck them with the edge of the sword. The runners and officers threw them out and went as far as the city of Baal’s house.

verses.text: They pulled down Baal’s pillars and tore down Baal’s house, making it latrines to this day.

verses.text: Yet Jehu did not turn away from following the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who caused Israel to sin: the golden heifers in Bethel and in Dan.

verses.text: The Lord said to Jehu, ‘Because you have done well in doing what is upright in My eyes, and have done to Ahab’s house everything that was in My heart, sons of yours to the fourth generation will sit on Israel’s throne.’
verses.display_text: The Lord said to Jehu, ‘Because you have done well in doing what is upright in My eyes, and have done to Ahab’s house everything that was in My heart, sons of yours to the fourth generation will sit on Israel’s throne.’

verses.display_text: But Jehu did not take care to walk in the law of the Lord, the God of Israel, with his whole heart. He did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who caused Israel to sin.

verses.display_text: from the Jordan toward sunrise, all the land of Gilead belonging to Gad, Reuben, and Manasseh, from Aroer on the bank of the Arnon torrent, both Gilead and Bashan.

verses.text: Jehu lay down with his fathers, and they buried him in Samaria. Jehoahaz his son became king in his place.

verses.text: The days Jehu reigned over Israel were twenty-eight years in Samaria.
verses.display_text: The days Jehu reigned over Israel were twenty-eight years in Samaria.

verses.text: Athaliah, Ahaziah’s mother, saw that her sons had died, and destroyed all the royal offspring.
verses.display_text: Athaliah, Ahaziah’s mother, saw that her sons had died, and destroyed all the royal offspring.

verses.text: Jehosheba, daughter of King Joram and sister of Ahaziah, took Joash, her brother’s son, and stole him away from among the king’s sons who were being put to death—him and his nurse—in the chamber of the beds. She hid him from Athaliah, and he was not put to death.
verses.display_text: Jehosheba, daughter of King Joram and sister of Ahaziah, took Joash, her brother’s son, and stole him away from among the king’s sons who were being put to death—him and his nurse—in the chamber of the beds. She hid him from Athaliah, and he was not put to death.

verses.text: He remained with her in the Lord’s house, hidden for six years, while Athaliah was reigning over the land.
verses.display_text: He remained with her in the Lord’s house, hidden for six years, while Athaliah was reigning over the land.

verses.text: In the seventh year Jehoiada the priest sent for the captains of hundreds, the Chorri and the Rasim. He brought them to him into the Lord’s house, made a covenant of the Lord with them, put them under oath before the Lord, and Jehoiada showed them the king’s son.

verses.text: He commanded them, saying, ‘This is what you shall do: let a third of you enter on the Sabbath, and you shall guard the king’s house at the gateway,

verses.text: Surround the king on every side, each man with his equipment in his hand. Whoever enters the saderoth shall die.’ And he was with the king when he went out and came in.
verses.display_text: Surround the king on every side, each man with his equipment in his hand. Whoever enters the saderoth shall die.’ And he was with the king when he went out and came in.

verses.display_text: The captains of hundreds did everything Jehoiada the discerning one commanded. Each took his men entering on the Sabbath, together with those going out on the Sabbath, and came to Jehoiada the priest.

verses.text: The priest gave the captains of hundreds King David’s lances and threefold weapons that were in the Lord’s house.
verses.display_text: The priest gave the captains of hundreds King David’s lances and threefold weapons that were in the Lord’s house.

verses.text: The runners stood, each man with his equipment in his hand, from the house’s right flank to its left flank, beside the altar and the house, all around the king.
verses.display_text: The runners stood, each man with his equipment in his hand, from the house’s right flank to its left flank, beside the altar and the house, all around the king.

verses.text: He brought out the king’s son and put the nezer and the testimony upon him. He made him king and anointed him, and they clapped their hands and said, ‘Long live the king!’
verses.display_text: He brought out the king’s son and put the nezer and the testimony upon him. He made him king and anointed him, and they clapped their hands and said, ‘Long live the king!’

verses.text: Athaliah heard the sound of the running people and entered among the people in the Lord’s house.
verses.display_text: Athaliah heard the sound of the running people and entered among the people in the Lord’s house.

verses.text: She looked, and there was the king standing by the pillar according to the ordinance, with the singers and trumpets beside the king. All the people of the land were rejoicing and sounding trumpets. Athaliah tore her garments and cried, ‘Conspiracy! Conspiracy!’
verses.display_text: She looked, and there was the king standing by the pillar according to the ordinance, with the singers and trumpets beside the king. All the people of the land were rejoicing and sounding trumpets. Athaliah tore her garments and cried, ‘Conspiracy! Conspiracy!’

verses.text: Jehoiada the priest commanded the captains of hundreds, the army’s overseers, and said to them, ‘Bring her out from inside the saderoth. Whoever enters after her shall certainly be put to death by the sword.’ For the priest had said, ‘She must not die in the Lord’s house.’
verses.display_text: Jehoiada the priest commanded the captains of hundreds, the army’s overseers, and said to them, ‘Bring her out from inside the saderoth. Whoever enters after her shall certainly be put to death by the sword.’ For the priest had said, ‘She must not die in the Lord’s house.’

verses.text: They laid hands on her. She entered by the way of the horses’ entrance of the king’s house, and died there.
verses.display_text: They laid hands on her. She entered by the way of the horses’ entrance of the king’s house, and died there.

verses.text: Jehoiada made a covenant between the Lord, the king, and the people, that they should be the Lord’s people, and between the king and the people.
verses.display_text: Jehoiada made a covenant between the Lord, the king, and the people, that they should be the Lord’s people, and between the king and the people.

verses.text: All the people of the land entered Baal’s house and pulled it down. They thoroughly shattered its altars and images, and killed Mattan, Baal’s priest, before the altars. The priest appointed overseers for the Lord’s house.
verses.display_text: All the people of the land entered Baal’s house and pulled it down. They thoroughly shattered its altars and images, and killed Mattan, Baal’s priest, before the altars. The priest appointed overseers for the Lord’s house.

verses.text: He took the captains of hundreds, the Chorri, the Rasim, and all the people of the land. They brought the king down from the Lord’s house. He entered the king’s house by the way of the Runners’ Gate, and they seated him on the throne of the kings.
verses.display_text: He took the captains of hundreds, the Chorri, the Rasim, and all the people of the land. They brought the king down from the Lord’s house. He entered the king’s house by the way of the Runners’ Gate, and they seated him on the throne of the kings.

verses.text: All the people of the land rejoiced, and the city became quiet. They had put Athaliah to death by the sword in the king’s house.
verses.display_text: All the people of the land rejoiced, and the city became quiet. They had put Athaliah to death by the sword in the king’s house.

verses.text: Joash was seven years old when he became king.
verses.display_text: Joash was seven years old when he became king.

verses.text: In Jehu’s seventh year Joash became king, and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Abia of Beersheba.
verses.display_text: In Jehu’s seventh year Joash became king, and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Abia of Beersheba.

verses.text: Joash did what was upright before the Lord all the days in which Jehoiada the priest enlightened him.
verses.display_text: Joash did what was upright before the Lord all the days in which Jehoiada the priest enlightened him.

verses.text: Yet the high places were not removed, and the people were still sacrificing and burning incense there at the high places.
verses.display_text: Yet the high places were not removed, and the people were still sacrificing and burning incense there at the high places.

verses.text: Joash said to the priests, ‘All the silver of the holy things received into the Lord’s house—silver of assessment, each man taking silver of assessment, and all silver that may arise in a man’s heart to bring into the Lord’s house—
verses.display_text: Joash said to the priests, ‘All the silver of the holy things received into the Lord’s house—silver of assessment, each man taking silver of assessment, and all silver that may arise in a man’s heart to bring into the Lord’s house—

verses.text: let the priests receive it for themselves, each from their sale, and they shall strengthen the bedek of the house wherever bedek is found.’
verses.display_text: let the priests receive it for themselves, each from their sale, and they shall strengthen the bedek of the house wherever bedek is found.’

verses.text: In the twenty-third year of King Joash, the priests had not strengthened the bedek of the house.
verses.display_text: In the twenty-third year of King Joash, the priests had not strengthened the bedek of the house.

verses.text: King Joash called Jehoiada the priest and the priests and said to them, ‘Why are you not strengthening the bedek of the house? Now take no silver from your sales, but give it for the bedek of the house.’
verses.display_text: King Joash called Jehoiada the priest and the priests and said to them, ‘Why are you not strengthening the bedek of the house? Now take no silver from your sales, but give it for the bedek of the house.’

verses.text: The priests agreed neither to take silver from the people nor to strengthen the bedek of the house.
verses.display_text: The priests agreed neither to take silver from the people nor to strengthen the bedek of the house.

verses.text: Jehoiada the priest took a chest, bored a hole in its board, and placed it beside Iamibin, in the house of a man of the Lord’s house. The priests guarding the doorpost put in all the silver found in the Lord’s house.
verses.display_text: Jehoiada the priest took a chest, bored a hole in its board, and placed it beside Iamibin, in the house of a man of the Lord’s house. The priests guarding the doorpost put in all the silver found in the Lord’s house.

verses.text: Whenever they saw that there was much silver in the chest, the king’s scribe and the high priest came up. They bound up and counted the silver found in the Lord’s house.
verses.display_text: Whenever they saw that there was much silver in the chest, the king’s scribe and the high priest came up. They bound up and counted the silver found in the Lord’s house.

verses.display_text: They placed the prepared silver in the hands of those doing the work, the overseers of the Lord’s house. They paid it out to the carpenters and builders working on the Lord’s house,

verses.text: to the wall builders and stone quarriers, to acquire timber and quarried stones to make firm the bedek of the Lord’s house, for everything spent on strengthening the house.
verses.display_text: to the wall builders and stone quarriers, to acquire timber and quarried stones to make firm the bedek of the Lord’s house, for everything spent on strengthening the house.

verses.text: But silver doors, nails, bowls, trumpets, or any gold or silver vessel were not to be made for the Lord’s house from the silver brought into the Lord’s house.

verses.display_text: They would give it to those doing the work, and with it they strengthened the Lord’s house.

verses.display_text: They did not call the men to account into whose hands they placed the silver to give to those doing the work, for they acted in their trustworthiness.

verses.text: Silver for sin and silver for trespass, whatever was brought into the Lord’s house, belonged to the priests.

verses.display_text: Then Hazael king of Syria went up, fought against Gath, and seized it. Hazael set his face to go up against Jerusalem.

He sent them to Hazael king of Syria, and he went away from Jerusalem.

verses.display_text: His slaves rose, bound together a conspiracy, and struck Joash in the house of Mallo in Gaalla.

verses.display_text: Jezichar son of Jemuath and Jezebuth—his son Shomer—his slaves, struck him, and he died. They buried him with his fathers in the city of David, and Amaziah his son became king in his place.

verses.text: In the twenty-third year of Joash son of Ahaziah, king of Judah, Jehoahaz son of Jehu became king in Samaria, for seventeen years.
verses.display_text: In the twenty-third year of Joash son of Ahaziah, king of Judah, Jehoahaz son of Jehu became king in Samaria, for seventeen years.

verses.display_text: He did evil in the Lord’s eyes and followed the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who caused Israel to sin; he did not turn away from them.

verses.text: The Lord was fiercely angry with Israel, and He gave them into the hand of Hazael king of Syria and into the hand of the son of Ader, Hazael’s son, all those days.
verses.display_text: The Lord was fiercely angry with Israel, and He gave them into the hand of Hazael king of Syria and into the hand of the son of Ader, Hazael’s son, all those days.

verses.display_text: Hazael afflicted Israel all Jehoahaz’s days.

verses.text: The Lord had mercy on them, pitied them, and looked toward them because of His covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. The Lord was unwilling to destroy them and did not cast them from His presence.
verses.display_text: The Lord had mercy on them, pitied them, and looked toward them because of His covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. The Lord was unwilling to destroy them and did not cast them from His presence.

verses.text: Hazael king of Syria died, and his son, the son of Ader, became king in his place.
verses.display_text: Hazael king of Syria died, and his son, the son of Ader, became king in his place.

verses.text: Joash son of Jehoahaz took back from the son of Ader, Hazael’s son, the towns he had taken in war from his father Jehoahaz. Joash struck him three times and recovered Israel’s towns.
verses.display_text: Joash son of Jehoahaz took back from the son of Ader, Hazael’s son, the towns he had taken in war from his father Jehoahaz. Joash struck him three times and recovered Israel’s towns.

verses.text: In the second year of Joash son of Jehoahaz, king of Israel, Amaziah son of Joash, king of Judah, became king.
verses.display_text: In the second year of Joash son of Jehoahaz, king of Israel, Amaziah son of Joash, king of Judah, became king.

verses.text: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Joadin, from Jerusalem.
verses.display_text: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Joadin, from Jerusalem.

verses.text: He did what was right in the Lord’s eyes, though not like his father David. He did in accordance with everything his father Joash had done.
verses.display_text: He did what was right in the Lord’s eyes, though not like his father David. He did in accordance with everything his father Joash had done.

verses.text: Only he did not remove the high places; the people still sacrificed and burned incense at the high places.
verses.display_text: Only he did not remove the high places; the people still sacrificed and burned incense at the high places.

verses.text: When the kingdom was firmly in his hand, he struck down his servants who had struck down his father.
verses.display_text: When the kingdom was firmly in his hand, he struck down his servants who had struck down his father.

verses.text: But he did not put the killers’ sons to death, as written in the book of Moses’ laws, as the Lord commanded: ‘Fathers shall not die for sons, and sons shall not die for fathers; each shall die only for his own sins.’
verses.display_text: But he did not put the killers’ sons to death, as written in the book of Moses’ laws, as the Lord commanded: ‘Fathers shall not die for sons, and sons shall not die for fathers; each shall die only for his own sins.’

verses.text: He struck down ten thousand of Edom in Gaimela, captured the Rock in battle, and named it Kathoel, to this day.
verses.display_text: He struck down ten thousand of Edom in Gaimela, captured the Rock in battle, and named it Kathoel, to this day.

verses.text: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Joash son of Jehoahaz son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, ‘Come, let us face one another.’
verses.display_text: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Joash son of Jehoahaz son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, ‘Come, let us face one another.’

verses.text: Joash king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, ‘The thornbush in Lebanon sent to the cedar in Lebanon: “Give your daughter to my son as a wife.” But the wild animals in Lebanon passed by and trampled the thornbush.

verses.text: You have indeed struck Idumea, and your heart has lifted you up. Enjoy glory while sitting at home! Why contend in your wickedness? You will fall, you and Judah with you.’
verses.display_text: You have indeed struck Idumea, and your heart has lifted you up. Enjoy glory while sitting at home! Why contend in your wickedness? You will fall, you and Judah with you.’

verses.text: Amaziah did not listen. The king of Israel went up, and he and Amaziah king of Judah faced one another at Baithsamys in Judah.
verses.display_text: Amaziah did not listen. The king of Israel went up, and he and Amaziah king of Judah faced one another at Baithsamys in Judah.

verses.text: Judah stumbled before Israel, and each man fled to his dwelling.
verses.display_text: Judah stumbled before Israel, and each man fled to his dwelling.

verses.text: Joash son of Jehoahaz, king of Israel, captured Amaziah son of Joash son of Ahaziah, king of Judah, at Baithsamys. He came to Jerusalem and pulled down four hundred cubits of Jerusalem’s wall, from the Ephraim Gate to the Corner Gate.
verses.display_text: Joash son of Jehoahaz, king of Israel, captured Amaziah son of Joash son of Ahaziah, king of Judah, at Baithsamys. He came to Jerusalem and pulled down four hundred cubits of Jerusalem’s wall, from the Ephraim Gate to the Corner Gate.

verses.text: He took the gold and silver, all the vessels found in the Lord’s house and in the treasuries of the king’s house, and the sons of the mixed unions, and returned to Samaria.
verses.display_text: He took the gold and silver, all the vessels found in the Lord’s house and in the treasuries of the king’s house, and the sons of the mixed unions, and returned to Samaria.

verses.text: The rest of Joash’s deeds, what he did in his might, how he fought Amaziah king of Judah—are these not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.display_text: The rest of Joash’s deeds, what he did in his might, how he fought Amaziah king of Judah—are these not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

verses.text: Joash lay down with his fathers and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel. His son Jeroboam became king in his place.
verses.display_text: Joash lay down with his fathers and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel. His son Jeroboam became king in his place.

verses.text: Amaziah son of Joash, king of Judah, lived fifteen years after the death of Joash son of Jehoahaz, king of Israel.
verses.display_text: Amaziah son of Joash, king of Judah, lived fifteen years after the death of Joash son of Jehoahaz, king of Israel.

verses.text: The rest of Amaziah’s deeds and everything he did—are these not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.display_text: The rest of Amaziah’s deeds and everything he did—are these not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

verses.text: They formed a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem, and he fled to Lachish. They sent after him to Lachish and put him to death there.
verses.display_text: They formed a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem, and he fled to Lachish. They sent after him to Lachish and put him to death there.

verses.text: They carried him on horses, and he was buried in Jerusalem with his fathers in David’s city.
verses.display_text: They carried him on horses, and he was buried in Jerusalem with his fathers in David’s city.

verses.text: All the people of Judah took Azariah—he was sixteen years old—and made him king in place of his father Amaziah.
verses.display_text: All the people of Judah took Azariah—he was sixteen years old—and made him king in place of his father Amaziah.

verses.text: He built Ailoth and restored it to Judah after the king lay down with his fathers.
verses.display_text: He built Ailoth and restored it to Judah after the king lay down with his fathers.

verses.text: In the fifteenth year of Amaziah son of Joash, king of Judah, Jeroboam son of Joash became king over Israel in Samaria, for forty-one years.
verses.display_text: In the fifteenth year of Amaziah son of Joash, king of Judah, Jeroboam son of Joash became king over Israel in Samaria, for forty-one years.

verses.text: He did evil before the Lord. He did not turn away from any of the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who caused Israel to sin.
verses.display_text: He did evil before the Lord. He did not turn away from any of the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who caused Israel to sin.

verses.text: He shifted Israel’s boundary from the entrance of Aimath to the Sea of the Arabah, according to the word of the Lord, Israel’s God, which He spoke through His servant Jonah son of Amathi, the prophet from Gethchober.
verses.display_text: He shifted Israel’s boundary from the entrance of Aimath to the Sea of the Arabah, according to the word of the Lord, Israel’s God, which He spoke through His servant Jonah son of Amathi, the prophet from Gethchober.

verses.text: For the Lord saw Israel’s humiliation was very bitter, and they were few, hemmed in, impoverished, and abandoned; there was no one helping Israel.
verses.display_text: For the Lord saw Israel’s humiliation was very bitter, and they were few, hemmed in, impoverished, and abandoned; there was no one helping Israel.

verses.text: The Lord had not spoken of blotting out Israel’s seed from beneath heaven, and He saved them through Jeroboam son of Joash.
verses.display_text: The Lord had not spoken of blotting out Israel’s seed from beneath heaven, and He saved them through Jeroboam son of Joash.

verses.text: The rest of Jeroboam’s deeds, all that he did, his mighty acts, all his warfare, and how he restored Damascus and Aimath to Judah in Israel—are these not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.display_text: The rest of Jeroboam’s deeds, all that he did, his mighty acts, all his warfare, and how he restored Damascus and Aimath to Judah in Israel—are these not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

verses.text: Jeroboam lay down with his fathers, with Israel’s kings, and Azariah son of Amaziah became king in place of his father.
verses.display_text: Jeroboam lay down with his fathers, with Israel’s kings, and Azariah son of Amaziah became king in place of his father.

verses.text: In the twenty-seventh year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Azariah son of Amaziah, king of Judah, became king.
verses.display_text: In the twenty-seventh year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Azariah son of Amaziah, king of Judah, became king.

verses.text: He was sixteen years old when he became king, and he reigned fifty-two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Chalia, from Jerusalem.
verses.display_text: He was sixteen years old when he became king, and he reigned fifty-two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Chalia, from Jerusalem.

verses.text: He did what was right in the Lord’s eyes, in accordance with everything his father Amaziah had done.
verses.display_text: He did what was right in the Lord’s eyes, in accordance with everything his father Amaziah had done.

verses.text: Only he did not remove the high places; the people still sacrificed and burned incense at the high places.
verses.display_text: Only he did not remove the high places; the people still sacrificed and burned incense at the high places.

verses.text: The Lord touched the king, and he was leprous until the day of his death. He reigned in the house of Apphousoth, while Jotham the king’s son was over the house, judging the people of the land.
verses.display_text: The Lord touched the king, and he was leprous until the day of his death. He reigned in the house of Apphousoth, while Jotham the king’s son was over the house, judging the people of the land.

verses.text: The rest of Azariah’s deeds and all that he did—behold, are these not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.display_text: The rest of Azariah’s deeds and all that he did—behold, are these not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

verses.text: Azariah lay down with his fathers, and they buried him with his fathers in David’s city. His son Jotham became king in his place.
verses.display_text: Azariah lay down with his fathers, and they buried him with his fathers in David’s city. His son Jotham became king in his place.

verses.text: In the thirty-eighth year of Azariah king of Judah, Zechariah son of Jeroboam became king over Israel in Samaria, for six months.
verses.display_text: In the thirty-eighth year of Azariah king of Judah, Zechariah son of Jeroboam became king over Israel in Samaria, for six months.

verses.text: He did evil in the Lord’s eyes as his fathers had done. He did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who caused Israel to sin.
verses.display_text: He did evil in the Lord’s eyes as his fathers had done. He did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who caused Israel to sin.

verses.text: Sellum son of Jabis and Keblaam conspired against him, struck him, and put him to death; Sellum became king in his place.
verses.display_text: Sellum son of Jabis and Keblaam conspired against him, struck him, and put him to death; Sellum became king in his place.

verses.text: The rest of Zechariah’s deeds—behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
verses.display_text: The rest of Zechariah’s deeds—behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

verses.text: The Lord’s word which He spoke to Jehu was: ‘Your sons to the fourth generation shall sit on Israel’s throne.’ And so it happened.
verses.display_text: The Lord’s word which He spoke to Jehu was: ‘Your sons to the fourth generation shall sit on Israel’s throne.’ And so it happened.

verses.text: Sellum son of Jabis became king. In the thirty-ninth year of Azariah king of Judah, Sellum reigned a month of days in Samaria.
verses.display_text: Sellum son of Jabis became king. In the thirty-ninth year of Azariah king of Judah, Sellum reigned a month of days in Samaria.

verses.text: Manaem son of Gaddi went up from Tharsila, came to Samaria, struck Sellum son of Jabis in Samaria, and put him to death.
verses.display_text: Manaem son of Gaddi went up from Tharsila, came to Samaria, struck Sellum son of Jabis in Samaria, and put him to death.

verses.text: The rest of Sellum’s deeds and the conspiracy he formed—behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
verses.display_text: The rest of Sellum’s deeds and the conspiracy he formed—behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

verses.text: Then Manaem struck Thersa, everything in it, and its territory from Thersa, because they did not open to him. He struck it and ripped open the pregnant women.
verses.display_text: Then Manaem struck Thersa, everything in it, and its territory from Thersa, because they did not open to him. He struck it and ripped open the pregnant women.

verses.text: In the thirty-ninth year of Azariah king of Judah, Manaem son of Gaddi became king over Israel for ten years in Samaria.
verses.display_text: In the thirty-ninth year of Azariah king of Judah, Manaem son of Gaddi became king over Israel for ten years in Samaria.

verses.text: He did evil in the Lord’s eyes. He did not turn away from any of the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who caused Israel to sin.
verses.display_text: He did evil in the Lord’s eyes. He did not turn away from any of the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who caused Israel to sin.

verses.text: In his days Phul king of the Assyrians went up against the land. Manaem gave Phul a thousand talents of silver so that his hand would be with him.
verses.display_text: In his days Phul king of the Assyrians went up against the land. Manaem gave Phul a thousand talents of silver so that his hand would be with him.

verses.text: Manaem exacted the silver from Israel, from everyone mighty in strength, to give to the king of the Assyrians: fifty shekels for each man. The king of the Assyrians returned and did not remain there in the land.
verses.display_text: Manaem exacted the silver from Israel, from everyone mighty in strength, to give to the king of the Assyrians: fifty shekels for each man. The king of the Assyrians returned and did not remain there in the land.

verses.text: The rest of Manaem’s deeds and all that he did—behold, are these not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.display_text: The rest of Manaem’s deeds and all that he did—behold, are these not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

verses.text: Manaem lay down with his fathers, and his son Phakeias became king in his place.
verses.display_text: Manaem lay down with his fathers, and his son Phakeias became king in his place.

verses.text: In the fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah, Phakeias son of Manaem became king over Israel in Samaria, for two years.
verses.display_text: In the fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah, Phakeias son of Manaem became king over Israel in Samaria, for two years.

verses.text: He did evil in the Lord’s eyes. He did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who caused Israel to sin.
verses.display_text: He did evil in the Lord’s eyes. He did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who caused Israel to sin.

verses.text: Phakee son of Romelias, his third-ranking officer, conspired against him and struck him in Samaria, in front of the king’s house, with Argob and Aria. With him were fifty men from the four hundred. He put him to death and became king in his place.
verses.display_text: Phakee son of Romelias, his third-ranking officer, conspired against him and struck him in Samaria, in front of the king’s house, with Argob and Aria. With him were fifty men from the four hundred. He put him to death and became king in his place.

verses.text: The rest of Phakeias’s deeds and all that he did—behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
verses.display_text: The rest of Phakeias’s deeds and all that he did—behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

verses.text: In the fifty-second year of Azariah king of Judah, Phakee son of Romelias became king over Israel in Samaria, for twenty years.
verses.display_text: In the fifty-second year of Azariah king of Judah, Phakee son of Romelias became king over Israel in Samaria, for twenty years.

verses.text: He did evil in the Lord’s eyes. He did not turn away from any of the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who caused Israel to sin.
verses.display_text: He did evil in the Lord’s eyes. He did not turn away from any of the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who caused Israel to sin.

verses.text: In the days of Phakee king of Israel, Thaglathphellasar king of the Assyrians came and took Ain, Abelbaithamaacha, Janoch, Kenez, Asor, Gilead, and Galilee, all Naphtali’s land, and deported them to the Assyrians.
verses.display_text: In the days of Phakee king of Israel, Thaglathphellasar king of the Assyrians came and took Ain, Abelbaithamaacha, Janoch, Kenez, Asor, Gilead, and Galilee, all Naphtali’s land, and deported them to the Assyrians.

verses.text: Hoshea son of Ela formed a conspiracy against Phakee son of Romelias, struck him, put him to death, and became king in his place, in the twentieth year of Jotham son of Azariah.
verses.display_text: Hoshea son of Ela formed a conspiracy against Phakee son of Romelias, struck him, put him to death, and became king in his place, in the twentieth year of Jotham son of Azariah.

verses.text: The rest of Phakee’s deeds and all that he did—behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
verses.display_text: The rest of Phakee’s deeds and all that he did—behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

verses.text: In the second year of Phakee son of Romelias, king of Israel, Jotham son of Azariah, king of Judah, became king.
verses.display_text: In the second year of Phakee son of Romelias, king of Israel, Jotham son of Azariah, king of Judah, became king.

verses.text: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jerusa daughter of Sadok.
verses.display_text: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jerusa daughter of Sadok.

verses.text: He did what was right in the Lord’s eyes, in accordance with everything his father Ozias had done.
verses.display_text: He did what was right in the Lord’s eyes, in accordance with everything his father Ozias had done.

verses.display_text: Only he did not remove the high places; the people still sacrificed and burned incense at the high places. He built the upper gate of the Lord’s house.

verses.text: The rest of Jotham’s deeds and everything he did—are these not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.display_text: The rest of Jotham’s deeds and everything he did—are these not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

verses.text: In those days the Lord began sending Raasson king of Syria and Phakee son of Romelias against Judah.
verses.display_text: In those days the Lord began sending Raasson king of Syria and Phakee son of Romelias against Judah.

verses.text: Jotham lay down with his fathers and was buried with his fathers in the city of his father David. His son Ahaz became king in his place.
verses.display_text: Jotham lay down with his fathers and was buried with his fathers in the city of his father David. His son Ahaz became king in his place.

verses.text: In the seventeenth year of Phakee son of Romelias, Ahaz son of Jotham, king of Judah, became king.
verses.display_text: In the seventeenth year of Phakee son of Romelias, Ahaz son of Jotham, king of Judah, became king.

verses.text: Ahaz was twenty years old when he became king, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. He did not faithfully do what was right in the eyes of the Lord his God, as his father David had done.
verses.display_text: Ahaz was twenty years old when he became king, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. He did not faithfully do what was right in the eyes of the Lord his God, as his father David had done.

verses.text: He walked in the way of Jeroboam son of Nebat, king of Israel. He even led his son through fire, according to the abominations of the nations whom the Lord removed before the Israelites.
verses.display_text: He walked in the way of Jeroboam son of Nebat, king of Israel. He even led his son through fire, according to the abominations of the nations whom the Lord removed before the Israelites.

verses.text: He sacrificed and burned incense at the high places, on the hills, and under every leafy tree.
verses.display_text: He sacrificed and burned incense at the high places, on the hills, and under every leafy tree.

verses.text: Then Raasson king of Syria and Phakee son of Romelias, king of Israel, went up to Jerusalem for war. They besieged Ahaz but could not wage the battle successfully.
verses.display_text: Then Raasson king of Syria and Phakee son of Romelias, king of Israel, went up to Jerusalem for war. They besieged Ahaz but could not wage the battle successfully.

verses.text: At that time Raasson king of Syria restored Ailath to Syria and expelled the Judeans from Ailath. Idumeans came to Ailath and lived there to this day.
verses.display_text: At that time Raasson king of Syria restored Ailath to Syria and expelled the Judeans from Ailath. Idumeans came to Ailath and lived there to this day.

verses.text: Ahaz sent messengers to Thaglathphellasar king of the Assyrians, saying, ‘I am your slave and your son. Come up and save me from the hand of the king of Syria and the hand of the king of Israel, who are rising against me.’
verses.display_text: Ahaz sent messengers to Thaglathphellasar king of the Assyrians, saying, ‘I am your slave and your son. Come up and save me from the hand of the king of Syria and the hand of the king of Israel, who are rising against me.’

verses.text: Ahaz took the silver and gold found in the treasuries of the Lord’s house and the king’s house, and sent gifts to the king.
verses.display_text: Ahaz took the silver and gold found in the treasuries of the Lord’s house and the king’s house, and sent gifts to the king.

verses.text: The king of the Assyrians listened to him. The king of the Assyrians went up against Damascus, captured it, deported it, and put Raasson to death.
verses.display_text: The king of the Assyrians listened to him. The king of the Assyrians went up against Damascus, captured it, deported it, and put Raasson to death.

verses.text: King Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Thaglathphellasar king of the Assyrians. He saw the altar in Damascus, and King Ahaz sent Uriah the priest the altar’s likeness and design for all its construction.
verses.display_text: King Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Thaglathphellasar king of the Assyrians. He saw the altar in Damascus, and King Ahaz sent Uriah the priest the altar’s likeness and design for all its construction.

verses.display_text: Uriah the priest built the altar in accordance with everything King Ahaz sent from Damascus.

verses.text: King Ahaz cut apart the enclosures of the mechonoth and removed the basin from them. He took the Sea down from the bronze oxen beneath it and placed it on a stone base.

verses.text: Ahaz lay down with his fathers and was buried in David’s city. His son Hezekiah became king in his place.

verses.text: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah, Hoshea son of Ela became king in Samaria over Israel, for nine years.
